item.title: Natural radiation can give quartz a smoky color
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Natural irradiation can darken quartz containing trace aluminum, producing the tint of smoky quartz.
EXIMUTC view: Judge the color in consistent lighting and ask for treatment disclosure when it matters.
Source: digital.sciencehistory.org https://digital.sciencehistory.org/works/lrrbsbm
